title: tephrosia virginiana var. mohrii
intro: Tephrosia virginiana var. mohrii, commonly known as Mohr's spider flower, is a perennial legume native to the southeastern United States. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mohr's spider flower include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
